data.description:
## Context
README workflow prose conflicts with current claim, graph, help, and close behavior. The dispatcher fix on `chartreuse-interested-viper`, the assignee correction on `weariless-scrapable-mouse`, the quickstart work on `tsunamic-wax-hog`, and ADR 0100 define the historical basis. F12 must complete command discovery before this story finalizes help wording.

## Plan
- Document default claim assignment and Jira-resolvable explicit overrides.
- Name all seven relations, including `caused_by`.
- Document optional relation-scoped unlink.
- Describe help recognition before `--` while preserving nested `bridge` and `audit` handling.
- Describe integrated completion verification for task, bug, story, and epic closes.
- Preserve the tested quickstart and existing README structure.
- Leave demonstration assets for F16.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Generic claim guidance omits an explicit assignee and explains valid overrides.
- [ ] Link guidance names all seven relations.
- [ ] Unlink guidance documents omitted and explicit relation behavior.
- [ ] Help guidance matches leaf and nested command behavior.
- [ ] Close guidance covers ordinary work-ticket completion verification.
- [ ] The README quickstart check and targeted documentation checks pass.
- [ ] No demonstration asset or unrelated README section changes.
data.title: F08A correct README workflow contracts
